operations.description: Separately prepare the Grignard reagent from activated (sanded) magnesium turnings (1.3 g, 52.5 mmol, 2.15 equiv), dry THF (50 mL), a few drops of dry 1,2-dibromoethane and one selected alkyl-bromide substrate. The source reports overnight stirring at room temperature, then filtered cannula transfer into the chilled chlorophosphite solution. The substrate condition cards are alternatives, not a combined charge.

operations.description: In an argon-filled glovebox, charge diethyl chlorophosphite (3913.8 mg, 3.595 mL, 25 mmol, 1.00 equiv) and dry THF (50 mL) to a 250 mL Schlenk flask; transfer to the Schlenk line and cool to 0 °C. Add the separately prepared Grignard mixture by filtered cannula transfer, then stir overnight at 50 °C. Evaporate solvent; add concentrated HCl (5 mL) and water (75 mL), stir 2 h at room temperature, extract twice with DCM (75 mL each), dry over Na2SO4, concentrate, purify on silica with ethyl acetate and vacuum-dry overnight. The source reports ethyl (2-ethylhexyl)phosphinate ester at 2.5 g, 49%, or ethyl (oleyl)phosphinate ester at 1.6 g, 18.6%, for the corresponding substrate branch. These are alternative outcomes, not one combined run.

operations.description: In a 1 L flask, LiAlH4 (10 g, 260 mmol, 3.5 equiv) is degassed three times and placed under argon. Add dry THF (300 mL), cool to 0 °C, and add dried oleic acid (21.48 g, 24.0 mL, 76 mmol, 1.0 equiv) dropwise. Warm to room temperature and stir 4 h. Cool to 0 °C before carefully adding diethyl ether (400 mL), water (10 mL), 15% NaOH solution (10 mL), then water (32 mL); stir another 15 min. Dry with MgSO4, filter over Celite, vacuum-dry and vacuum-distill. Source reports colorless viscous product, 17.5 g (86%). This is a separate intermediate preparation, not a nanocrystal batch.

operations.description: Charge oleyl alcohol (13.42 g, 15.51 mL, 50 mmol, 1.0 equiv) in a 250 mL Schlenk flask, degas three times and place under argon. Add dry DCM (100 mL) and dried triethylamine (5.57 g, 7.67 mL, 55 mmol, 1.1 equiv); cool to 0 °C. Add dry mesyl chloride (6.30 g, 4.26 mL, 55 mmol, 1.1 equiv) dropwise and stir 30 min; add water (50 mL) and stir another 30 min. Retain organic phase; extract aqueous phase twice with chloroform (50 mL each). Combine organic phases; wash with 25% K2CO3 solution (25 mL) plus water (50 mL), then brine (50 mL); dry with MgSO4 and vacuum-dry. Product: colorless viscous liquid, 17.2 g (99%). This derivative is not linked as input to the oleyl-bromide route.

operations.description: Charge oleyl alcohol (13.42 g, 15.81 mL, 50 mmol, 1.0 equiv), tetrabromomethane (18.24 g, 55 mmol, 1.1 equiv) and dry DCM (50 mL) in a 250 mL flask; cool to 0 °C. Add triphenylphosphine (15.74 g, 60 mmol, 1.2 equiv) in portions over 15 min, then stir 1 h at room temperature. Add hexanes (50 mL), cool in a freezer to precipitate triphenylphosphine oxide, filter over silica plug and evaporate; repeat the cleanup a second time. Vacuum-dry overnight to remove bromoform and store refrigerated. Source reports colorless liquid, 16.3 g (98%). A separate diene procedure charges 16.57 g oleyl bromide; no same-lot identity is asserted.

operations.description: Charge oleyl bromide (16.57 g, 50 mmol, 1.0 equiv) to a 500 mL flask, evacuate and set under argon. Add dry THF (200 mL), cool to 0 °C and add 1 M KOtBu in THF (115 mL, 115 mmol, 2.3 equiv) dropwise. After the first equivalent, warm to room temperature and stir overnight. Add chloroform (200 mL), wash twice with water (200 mL each) and discard aqueous washes. Evaporate organic phase and vacuum-distill over CaH2. Source reports colorless (Z)-octadeca-1,9-diene, 9.4 g (75%). Distinct side preparation, not a nanocrystal-batch input; 16.57 g charge is not linked to the separate 16.3 g isolate.
